snippet.title: Daniel Radcliffe’s Sirius Bond With THIS Harry Potter Actor😱
snippet.description:
In this short we discuss the bond between Gary Oldman who played Sirius Black and Daniel Radcliffe while filming Harry Potter. The two were very close on set and it actually caused jealousy from Tom Felton. 

This channel is dedicated to providing the best Harry Potter content possible. I have been a life long Harry Potter fan and try to share interesting facts and theories about the series. If you enjoy this content please subscribe for more!
